Now step 3. Post InstallDatabase with UseBootstrap=1, DBHost=localhost, DBPort=3306, DBAdminUser=root. Let me do it and print the resulting page (look for password reveal). Then step4, step5 skip mail.

Let me also capture the DB password from the success page. Let's continue.

action.command: cat > /tmp/drive2.py <<'PY' import urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar, re, sys BASE="http://localhost/qisutu/install.pl" cj=http.cookiejar.CookieJar() op=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj), urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler()) def get(url=BASE): r=op.open(url); return r.geturl(), r.read().decode('utf-8','replace') def post(data,url=BASE): body=urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode() r=op.open(url, body); return r.geturl(), r.read().decode('utf-8','replace') def csrf(html): m=re.search(r'name="CSRFToken" value="([0-9a-f]+)"',html); return m.group(1) if m else None def report(url,html): m=re.search(r'(.*?)',html); print("URL:",url,"TITLE:",m.group(1) if m else '?') for e in re.findall(r'qisutu-install-error[^>]*>(.*?)',html,re.S): print(" ERROR:",re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',e).strip()) return html # Re-do steps url,html=get(); t=csrf(html) url,html=post({"Step":"1","Action":"Begin","CSRFToken":t}) url,html=get(BASE+"?Step=2"); t=csrf(html); report(url,html) url,html=post({"Step":"2","Action":"AcceptLicense","CSRFToken":t,"LicenseAccepted":"1"}) report(url,html) # Step3 url,html=get(BASE+"?Step=3"); t=csrf(html); report(url,html) post_data={"Step":"3","Action":"InstallDatabase","CSRFToken":t,"DBHost":"localhost","DBPort":"3306","DBName":"qisutu","DBUser":"qisutu","DBAdminUser":"root","DBAdminPassword":"","UseBootstrap":"1"} url,html=post(post_data); report(url,html) open('/tmp/step3.html','w').write(html) # extract db password m=re.search(r'id="qisutu-install-database-password-step3"[^>]*>([^<]+)<',html) print("DBPASS:", m.group(1) if m else "NOT FOUND") PY python3 /tmp/drive2.py
